ten: Buoc theo bac (doi buoc o moc so lenh)
mo_ta: Buoc doi theo so lenh: bac 1 cho lenh 2-9, bac 2 tu lenh 10, bac 3 ... (CCBSN Distance1-4, NuTi 'quang').
vet: Khoang cach gia giua cac lenh doi gia tri o nhung chi so lenh co dinh (vd lenh 10, 20, 30).

engine.ghi_chu: luoi.py chi co mot buoc + he so; chua co bang buoc theo tang.

ap_cheo: Khoi DE THU DAU: CCBSN la bot song sot duy nhat va dung 4 nac buoc; them vao luoi.py (+C +EA) la viec ro rang.
rui_ro: Nhieu tham so = de khop nhieu: phai quet cao nguyen, khong cai gai.
bang_chung_ghi_chu: chua co (the moi gieo, chua do)
